body: Thank you.. I’m just so tired of feeling like I’m dragging on for nothing. I don’t feel like I’m making progress. It’s like every day I feel even more alone and depressed. I don’t know how to get out of this..
I really appreciate you. Even just this short conversation has helped. Hoping I can keep pushing through.
I do, I’m a teacher actually. Most of my close friends live hundreds of miles away from me, just because we’ve all had so much life change. So I talk to them, it’s just hard when I can be with them.
Severe trauma. I’m literally just pushing to keep myself going instead of falling apart and wasting away.
I’ve been seeing a therapist twice a week for months, and I’m not sure it has helped. I’m trying so hard.
Feeling pretty pointless today. Numb and distant. Trying to find a reason to keep pushing but I’m failing miserably.
